papers.title_en: Continuous-time 4D Reconstruction via Event-guided Latent Feature Interpolation
papers.authors: Gwangtak Bae, Seunggu Kang, Junho Kim, Eun Sun Lee, Changwoon Choi, Young Min Kim
papers.evidence: 将几何基础模型扩展到连续时间三维结构与相机位姿重建
papers.tldr: 现有几何基础模型通常只能重建视频已观测时刻的三维结构，难以恢复帧间连续运动。本文提出事件引导的潜特征插值方法，并以图像空间事件损失辅助训练，从而在任意时间点估计三维结构和相机位姿。该工作把高时间分辨率事件信号融入已有视觉基础模型，为连续时间四维重建提供了新路径。
papers.abstract_en: Recent geometric foundation models can successfully convert a video sequence into frames of registered point clouds, but cannot predict moments beyond the observed temporal resolution. We propose a continuous-time 4D reconstruction method that extracts 3D structure and camera poses at any time instant, with additional guidance from event-camera measurements. While event cameras provide evidence at microsecond resolution to continuously fill the temporal gap, integrating them into existing RGB-based foundation models remains challenging. We formulate the problem as interpolation in the latent feature space and augment event-based losses in the image space as an auxiliary task to boost accuracy. Operating in the latent space leverages the powerful geometric priors of foundation models, while the event loss provides physically grounded guidance. To effectively address the lack of paired training data, we further propose a self-supervised training framework that uses pseudo-ground-truth labels of estimated geometry and simulated events generated from high-frame-rate RGB videos. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate that the proposed pipeline outperforms baselines that temporally interpolate either the input RGB videos or the estimated geometry, and that it generalizes to unseen real-world scenarios. Controlled experiments with synthetic corruptions show that it remains robust under motion-blur and low-light conditions.

papers.title_en: Seeing Together, Acting Apart: Shared Environmental Understanding for Multi-Robot Navigation
papers.authors: Haihong Hao, Lei Chen, Mingfei Han, Chenglong Yan, Dong An, Yuqiang Yang, Changlin Li, Minghao Guo, Salman Khan, Xiaojun Chang
papers.evidence: 融合多机器人观测形成共享环境表示以支持分布式导航
papers.tldr: 多机器人系统通常通过协调轨迹或联合策略实现协作，却较少先解决各机器人对环境认知不一致的问题。本文提出共享环境理解框架，将多个机器人的局部自我中心观测组织为共享潜在世界模型，并通过编码与检索支持信息融合。该表示与具体策略解耦，使机器人能够在共享环境上下文基础上分布式决策，为协同导航和空间感知提供了另一种实现方式。
papers.abstract_en: Multi-robot embodied systems are typically designed to collaborate by coordinating actions, sharing trajectories, or learning joint policies. We ask a complementary question: can collaboration emerge before decision-making, by first building a shared understanding of the environment? We introduce Shared Environmental Understanding, a policy-agnostic representation that aggregates partial egocentric observations from multiple robots into a shared latent world model. This shifts collaboration from the policy space to the representation space, enabling decentralized decision-making with shared environmental context. To this end, we propose Shared Environment Encoding and Retrieval (SEER), a framework that organizes multi-robot observations into a shared memory, retrieves relevant context via spatio-temporal similarity, and encodes it using a predictive latent world model. The resulting representations are injected into downstream navigation agents as tokens. Experimental results demonstrate that SEER captures action-relevant environmental structure and consistently improves navigation performance across both specialized VLN agents and general vision-language model agents, while preserving single-agent capabilities.

papers.title_en: MoGe-4D: Efficient, Flexible, and Unified Dense 4D Reconstruction and Tracking
papers.authors: Ruicheng Wang, Linlin Xin, Sicheng Xu, Jianfeng Xiang, Zelong Lv, Yu Deng, Yue Dong, Guangzhong Sun, Tong Zhang, Jiaolong Yang
papers.evidence: 前馈式动态四维重建统一估计几何、运动、深度、追踪与相机相对姿态
papers.tldr: 从视频重建动态场景需要同时处理三维几何、跨视角运动和相机关系，但现有方法常将重建与追踪拆成多个流程，或承担高昂的时空解码成本。MoGe-4D以成对的局部与全局动态点图查询统一前馈几何和运动预测，并通过闭式计算解析相对相机姿态。框架可支持深度估计、动态配准和稠密三维追踪，为高效的动态场景重建提供统一方案。
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing dynamic scenes from RGB video requires reasoning about both 3D geometry and motion across viewpoints, yet existing methods either split reconstruction and tracking into fragmented pipelines or face prohibitive dense spatiotemporal decoding costs. We introduce MoGe-4D, a feed-forward framework that unifies geometry and motion prediction via ordered queries of paired allocentric and egocentric dynamic point maps. Each query maps source pixels to a target time simultaneously in both camera frames, resolving relative camera pose in closed form while flexibly serving depth, dynamic registration, and dense 3D tracking. For efficient dense querying, MoGe-4D decouples scene modeling from query decoding: a high-capacity context encoder caches coarse global spatiotemporal features once, while a lightweight query encoder rapidly decodes dense point maps at flexible resolutions. Furthermore, as supervising dense 4D queries demands continuous 3D correspondences whose raw trajectory storage is prohibitive, we introduce RigIDTrack, a synthetic data pipeline and dataset that compresses surface dynamics into rigidity-regularized affine bodies, recovering exact arbitrary-frame 3D trajectories with $\sim15\%$ storage overhead over RGB-D video. Across diverse benchmarks, MoGe-4D achieves state-of-the-art dense 3D tracking, matches dedicated 3D foundation models in reconstruction, and runs substantially faster than prior 4D baselines.

papers.title_en: HS-OVSeg: Multi-Granularity Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation in Remote Sensing via Heterogeneous Supervision
papers.authors: Wei Huang, Chenying Liu, Xudong Kang, Xiao Xiang Zhu
papers.evidence: 开放词汇分割融合场景、对象与像素多个粒度的监督
papers.tldr: 遥感开放词汇语义分割需要灵活映射新类别，但像素级标注稀缺；已有数据中的场景级和对象级标签丰富，却难以直接提供精细边界。HS-OVSeg提出异质监督训练框架，统一利用场景、对象和像素粒度的信息，并生成像素伪标签来补充监督。该设计将不同层次的语义标注纳入同一分割流程，目标是在有限精细标注条件下拓展类别覆盖与像素预测能力，为多粒度场景解析提供了训练思路。
papers.abstract_en: Open-vocabulary semantic segmentation (OVSS) enables flexible, text-driven mapping of remote sensing (RS) imagery beyond predefined categories. Despite advances in segmentation foundation models, RS-OVSS remains constrained by the scarcity of large-scale, semantically diverse datasets with accurate pixel-level annotations. Meanwhile, existing RS datasets contain abundant scene- and object-level annotations that offer valuable semantic information but lack precise pixel-wise supervision. To exploit these complementary sources, we propose HS-OVSeg, a unified training framework that integrates heterogeneous scene-, object-, and pixel-level supervision for RS-OVSS. Specifically, we generate pixel-wise pseudo-labels using SAM3, conditioned on scene-level class names and object-level class names with bounding boxes. Combined with ground-truth semantic masks, these pseudo-labels enable joint training across all three annotation granularities through LoRA-based fine-tuning of SAM3. Our unified training spans 20 RS datasets, including 3 scene classification, 4 object detection, and 13 semantic segmentation datasets, with 1,000 images from the 7 classification and detection datasets manually annotated for pixel-level evaluation. HS-OVSeg substantially outperforms existing RS-OVSS models across both the 20 training-source and 5 held-out datasets, demonstrating strong multi-granularity segmentation capabilities under heterogeneous supervision. The code will be publicly available upon publication.

papers.title_en: Aqua2CAD : Observation-Guided Point Cloud Correction and Completion for CAD Reconstruction from Underwater Stereo Images
papers.authors: Weizhao Huang, Jiayi Zhang, Pangkit Fong, Chongrong Fang, Jianping He
papers.evidence: 校正并补全稀疏立体点云以重建CAD曲面
papers.tldr: 水下立体视觉生成的点云常存在偏移和缺失，而融合过程还会丢失原始视图中的射线与跨视角证据。Aqua2CAD先利用视图条件信息校正点并筛除低质量几何，再以多视图观测引导学习到的形状先验补全缺失表面。补全点云可用于曲面拟合和实体装配，合成基准结果显示点云误差降低，为稀疏观测下的可编辑模型重建提供了方法。
papers.abstract_en: Recovering editable computer-aided design (CAD) models from underwater stereo images requires accurate and complete geometry, yet stereo reconstruction produces displaced points and missing regions. The original views retain cross-view disagreement and ray evidence lost during point-cloud fusion. Aqua2CAD exploits this evidence in two stages: view-conditioned correction and quality filtering establish reliable geometric support, while multi-view observations condition a learned shape prior to infer missing surfaces in the original metric frame. The recovered points support surface fitting and solid assembly with manually revised face groups. On an OceanSim-based synthetic benchmark, Aqua2CAD reduces point-cloud Chamfer distance by 60% relative to the stereo reconstruction. Compared with a matched point-only completion backbone, it improves missing-region recovery at 5,mm from 16.27% to 24.16%. With a shared CAD backend, exterior acceptance increases from 6/19 to 14/19. Qualitative results on selected real underwater captures demonstrate recovery of the main structures of six 3D-printed objects.

papers.title_en: First-Hit Photoconsistency for Neural Surface Reconstruction
papers.authors: Gabriel Lenain, Edmond Boyer, Jean Ponce
papers.evidence: 利用多视图光度一致性与几何可见性进行神经隐式表面重建。
papers.tldr: 神经隐式与高斯泼溅表面重建常联合优化几何和外观，外观模型可能补偿错误几何，使图像拟合良好却无法得到准确表面。本文提出基于首次命中点的多视图局部光度一致性方法：对参考射线进行球面追踪，以交点和法线定义局部表面块，再结合几何可见性跨视角比较颜色。该方案不依赖体渲染或参数化外观模型，为更直接的神经表面重建提供了路径。
papers.abstract_en: Recent neural implicit and Gaussian splatting approaches have achieved impressive results in multi-view surface reconstruction. However, jointly optimizing geometry and appearance introduces ambiguities. A parametric appearance model can compensate for geometric errors, reproducing the input images accurately without an accurate surface. We demonstrate accurate neural implicit surface reconstruction using only multi-view patch photoconsistency with geometry-based visibility, without volumetric rendering or parametric appearance models. For each reference ray, sphere tracing computes the first surface intersection. Its position and normal define a local patch whose photoconsistency is evaluated across visible neighboring views using colors sampled directly from the input images. For efficient sphere tracing, we use a 1-Lipschitz multi-layer perceptron. We use a single photoconsistency loss, without foreground masks or auxiliary geometric regularization. Experiments show that our method achieves the lowest mean Chamfer distance on BlendedMVS (BMVS) among compared methods and matches the geometric accuracy of leading reconstruction methods on DTU.

papers.title_en: ROAM-Bench: Evaluating Embodied Active Spatial Intelligence through Evidence Verification
papers.authors: Xingjian Ran, Xiaoye Mo, Sihao Liu, Li Luo, Taiqiang Wu, Ji Zhao, Wenqi Shao, Hongyang Li, Jiaqi Wang, Bo Dai
papers.evidence: 通过可核验任务结果评测具身空间智能系统
papers.tldr: 具身空间智能体需要通过探索和交互获取信息，再据此推理并采取行动，但现有基准可能把完成流程误当作正确解决任务。ROAM-Bench利用仿真状态与任务记录独立核验结果，并纳入机器人运动和碰撞约束，覆盖搜索、计数、几何判断、方向推理及物体移动等任务。基准包含多个室内环境和经人工验证的任务，可更可靠地比较具身系统的空间能力。
papers.abstract_en: Embodied spatial intelligence requires agents to gather information through exploration and interaction, then use it to reason and act. Existing benchmarks insufficiently distinguish correct outcomes from completion of these task requirements. We introduce ROAM-Bench to evaluate these abilities under robot motion and collision constraints. Independent checks use simulation state and episode records to assess outcomes and task requirements, with stronger checks of geometry, coverage, or placement. It comprises 250 manually validated tasks across 11 types in five groups and 27 indoor environments, covering object and room search, counting, geometric judgments, direction reasoning, and relocation. Human evaluators achieve 84% strict task success on 100 sampled tasks, with every correct outcome satisfying the required checks. Across seven frontier vision-language models, we identify two complementary failure modes: correct outcomes with unmet task requirements, and incorrect outcomes despite passing stronger checks. Oracle-input diagnostics show that more complete target observations and calibrated feedback improve final spatial judgments.

papers.title_en: Improving Zero-shot 3D Semantic Mapping in Offroad with Geometric Priors
papers.authors: Eerik Alamikkotervo, Risto Ojala
papers.evidence: 以三维语义地图和几何先验增强机器人对越野环境的理解。
papers.tldr: 越野自然环境中的语义识别较结构化场景更困难，视觉基础模型的零样本预测容易失效，而点云包含可辅助区分类别的几何线索。本文利用高置信度语义预测，为各类别拟合球形度与高程分布，并将这些几何先验融合到语义映射中。该方法针对移动机器人导航场景增强三维环境理解，为复杂地形中的稳健感知提供了新的几何辅助思路。
papers.abstract_en: Semantic 3D mapping is a powerful representation that enables platform agnostic mobile robot navigation in challenging offroad conditions. Current vision foundation models can accurately predict semantics zero-shot on structured scenes but performance is compromised in natural environments. On the other hand, 3D point clouds encode valuable information for discriminating semantics in scenarios where vision foundation models fail. In this work, we propose fitting a sphericity-elevation distribution for each semantic class to act as geometric anchor. Only the points with the most confident vision foundation model predictions are considered when fitting to produce high quality geometric prior distributions. The geometric prior is fused with the vision foundation model prediction to produce the final semantic mapping. The proposed prior improves SAM3 baseline by +6.3 in mIoU and +8.9 in accuracy on the RELLIS-3D dataset, and by +1.7 in mIoU and +2.1 in accuracy on the WildScenes dataset. The source code will be made public upon paper acceptance.

papers.title_en: Which Way Is Up? Rotated Photos Silently Hurt Multi-View 3D Foundation Models
papers.authors: Yukun Shi, Minglun Gong
papers.evidence: 评估照片旋转对多视图三维基础模型相机位姿精度的影响。
papers.tldr: 多视图三维基础模型能够一次前向计算估计相机位姿与三维点，但照片方向标签被忽略或错误时，重建质量可能在不易察觉的情况下下降。本文在多个数据集上测试五种模型，系统分析旋转照片的影响，并发现少量方向异常图像就会降低位姿精度，模型置信度也未必能揭示问题。研究促使重建流程加入图像方向检查，补充了相机位姿估计模型的可靠性评测与实践注意事项。
papers.abstract_en: Multi-view 3D foundation models estimate camera poses and 3D points from a set of photos in one forward pass. Many cameras store a portrait shot sideways, with an orientation tag telling viewers how to turn it, and this tag can be ignored, lost or wrong. We measure how rotated photos affect five such models on three datasets. A few rotated photos lower camera pose accuracy for every model, and the sideways photos already in a standard benchmark do the same. Even the most robust model still loses accuracy. The failure is also silent: the models' confidence does not reliably flag it, and most official image loaders ignore the tag. The fixes we test each correct only part of the problem. These findings call for orientation checks in reconstruction pipelines and benchmarks.

papers.title_en: JointGV: Structure-Aware Correction of Visual World Models with Parallel Graph Dynamics for Long-Horizon Modeling
papers.authors: Tian Lyu, Yichen Jiang, Ziyuan Cheng, Yunda Yan, Xiangyu Pan, Junjie Jiang, Jialin Yu, Boyu Ning, Pietro Liò, Fan Mo
papers.evidence: 以场景图关系状态减少机器人世界模型长时预测漂移
papers.tldr: 以动作条件预测未来视觉状态的世界模型，常因递归误差而逐渐偏离实体姿态与空间关系，影响机器人长时规划。JointGV提出可插拔的结构感知校正方法，并行滚动任务条件场景图与视觉状态，借助二者变化对应同一物理转移的假设来修正漂移。摘要重点介绍方法机制而未报告量化结果；该工作探索了关系结构辅助视觉动力学预测的方向。
papers.abstract_en: Visual world models predict future visual states conditioned on actions, but recursive errors in entity poses and spatial relations limit their long-horizon prediction for robot planning and control. We ask whether a separately predicted relational state can correct this drift without restructuring the visual model. This is challenging because graph nodes and visual states share neither elements nor a feature space. We propose Joint Graph--Visual Dynamics Correction (JointGV), a plug-in based on a cross-granularity dynamics hypothesis: despite their different representations, graph-node and visual-state changes describe the same physical transition. JointGV rolls out a task-conditioned scene graph alongside the visual world model, couples their predicted changes, and combines the resulting graph-motion context with graph-predicted node positions to compute a bounded residual. Graph-learning and correction gradients do not propagate into the original visual dynamics. We attach JointGV to DINO-WM (spatial tokens) and DreamerV3 (a global latent state), evaluating both on DMC Cheetah Run and Walker Walk across three seeds and extending the evaluation to contact-rich manipulation with DMC Finger Turn Hard. Across 32-step rollouts, JointGV improves structural and visual-prediction accuracy, reducing joint-position error by 11--28\%. For spatial tokens, learned graph--visual change coupling gives lower error than broadcasting the same mean graph-motion context to every token, particularly when non-adjacent parts appear close together in the image. On real-robot inverted-pendulum sequences, JointGV reduces DINO-WM's 32-step pole-angle error from $12.56^\circ$ to $6.69^\circ$ and improves DreamerV3 and LeWorldModel as well. In simulated inverted-pendulum control, an actor trained with JointGV-corrected rollouts completes 46 of 50 episodes, compared with none using the original rollouts.

papers.title_en: SuperFine3D: Efficient Global-Local Recursive Refinement for Extremely Detailed 3D Geometry Generation
papers.authors: Lihan Li, Junwei Zhou, Yu-wing Tai
papers.evidence: 通过递归式由粗到细细化，从图像生成高细节三维几何。
papers.tldr: 从高分辨率图像生成细致三维几何需要大量计算资源和训练数据，现有模型也难以稳定扩展到更高分辨率。SuperFine3D从配对的粗细表示中学习共享细化算子，并结合全局与局部递归细化，重复使用该算子逐步合成更精细的几何结构，无需额外配对监督即可超越训练分辨率。该方法为图像驱动的三维重建提供了高效渐进式细节生成思路。
papers.abstract_en: High-resolution images contain rich visual details that require fine geometric structures for faithful 3D reconstruction. However, generating extremely detailed 3D geometry from images requires substantial computational resources and training data, making high-resolution geometry generation challenging for existing state-of-the-art models. In this paper, we present SuperFine3D, an efficient framework for generating extremely detailed 3D geometry through global-local recursive refinement. SuperFine3D learns a shared refinement operator from paired coarse-to-fine representations and recursively reuses it to progressively synthesize finer geometry beyond the training resolutions, without requiring additional paired supervision at target resolutions. To make recursive refinement computationally efficient, we introduce spatial-cell attention, which restricts high-resolution interactions to local spatial neighborhoods while maintaining bounded communication across neighboring cells. We further propose spatially anchored cross-scale guidance, which leverages globally contextualized coarse geometry to guide local detail synthesis and preserve structural consistency. In addition, geometry-aware training objectives encourage the refinement process to preserve stable geometric structures while introducing fine-grained surface details. Experiments demonstrate that SuperFine3D generates geometry at a $4096^3$ decoder-grid resolution, corresponding to a sparse $256^3$ latent lattice, using a shared refinement operator trained only on $512^3$--$1024^3$ representations. Compared with a full-attention recursive baseline, SuperFine3D achieves a $9.4\times$ speedup in end-to-end inference and reduces peak GPU memory usage by $23.0\%$, while improving cross-scale structural consistency and producing cleaner surfaces with finer geometric details.

papers.title_en: BridgeMVS: Bridging Multi-View Stereo and Monodepth via Bidirectional Dynamic Fusion
papers.authors: Jianfei Jiang, Haochen Yu, Qiankun Liu, Rui Yang, Hongyuan Liu, Xianglong Meng, Jiansheng Chen, Huimin Ma
papers.evidence: 融合多视图立体几何与单目深度线索进行稠密三维重建。
papers.tldr: 多视图立体能够恢复具有尺度的几何深度，但在纹理弱或匹配不可靠区域容易失败；单目深度具有稳定结构先验，却通常存在尺度歧义。本文提出BridgeMVS，在级联多阶段框架中通过双向动态融合连接单目深度特征与多视图代价体。该设计让两类线索相互补充，面向稠密三维重建中的困难区域提升几何恢复能力，属于表面与场景重建的直接相关工作。
papers.abstract_en: Multi-View Stereo (MVS) and Monocular Depth Estimation (MDE) provide complementary cues for dense 3D reconstruction. While MVS leverages explicit geometry for metric depth, it struggles in challenging regions where feature matching is unreliable. Conversely, MDE provides robust structural priors but typically yields scale-ambiguous results. Existing hybrid methods mainly exploit monocular cues in a unidirectional manner, leaving the mutual enhancement between MDE and MVS insufficiently explored. To address this limitation, we propose BridgeMVS, a unified cascaded multi-stage MVS framework that bridges monocular depth features and multi-view cost volume representations through Bidirectional Dynamic Fusion (BDF). At each stage, BDF performs dynamic mono-to-cost and cost-to-mono updates, where monocular structural features guide cost volume refinement for more robust MVS depth estimation, while multi-view geometric evidence recalibrates monocular representations to improve their metric-scale consistency. Furthermore, the fused monocular and multi-view representations are progressively propagated from coarse to fine stages and constrained by stage-wise relative-scale MDE supervision and metric-scale MVS supervision, enabling cross-branch interactions to benefit subsequent high-resolution depth estimation. In addition, BDF is designed as a plug-and-play module that can be conveniently integrated into existing cascaded MVS frameworks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that BridgeMVS achieves state-of-the-art performance on the DTU, Tanks-and-Temples, and ETH3D benchmarks, while simultaneously boosting the accuracy of monocular depth estimation. Notably, BridgeMVS ranks first on both the Tanks-and-Temples Intermediate and Advanced benchmarks. The source code is available at \href{https://github.com/JianfeiJ/BridgeMVS}{https://github.com/JianfeiJ/BridgeMVS}.

papers.title_en: InteractVLA: Turning VLAs into Interactive Tools for Agentic Robotic Manipulation
papers.authors: Chen Zhao, Zipeng Ye, Shifeng Bao, Yihan Lin, Haitao Shen, Yining Luo, Yuchen Xie, Jing Zhang
papers.evidence: 提升机器人操作策略的几何可控性
papers.tldr: 现有代理式机器人操作系统常把预训练视觉语言动作策略当作不透明的语言指令工具，一旦遇到陌生指令或场景变化便难以修正行为。InteractVLA构建视觉语言代理与动作策略之间的双向几何接口，并利用可微命令到位姿映射，将末端执行器目标转化为测试时引导。该框架旨在让策略更可控、可检查，减少无效重试和人工接管，为灵活的机器人操作提供新的交互方式。
papers.abstract_en: Existing agentic manipulation systems treat pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) policies as opaque, language-only primitives: when a policy call fails under unfamiliar instructions or scene perturbations, the agent cannot steer its behavior and is forced into futile retries or costly manual takeover. We present InteractVLA, a framework that turns pretrained flow-based VLAs into geometrically steerable and inspectable tools through a bidirectional geometric interface with vision-language agents. In the forward direction, test-time geometric guidance translates an agent-specified end-effector target into input gradients through the action expert via a differentiable command-to-pose mapping, while soft-time target alignment treats arrival time as a latent execution index to match the target pose without distorting the policy's approach motion. In the reverse direction, action-informed agentic refinement exposes generated action chunks and calibrated camera reprojections back to the agent, allowing it to diagnose spatial discrepancies, revise targets for subsequent VLA calls, or locally adjust motion segments on top of the guided trajectory. Making the VLA controllable not only boosts online agentic tool use, but also unlocks effective recursive self-improvement (RSI), achieving state-of-the-art performance of 99.4\% on LIBERO-Plus, 48.62\% on RoboDojo, and 89.4\% on RoboCasa365. Project page: https://lingwupro.github.io/InteractVLA/.

papers.title_en: VLM-guided Grounding Expert for Generalised Referring Expression Comprehension
papers.authors: Mingcheng Zhu, Wentian Xu, Tao Lin, Shiying Duan, Ziyun Liang, Xuecheng Qi, Junyang Chen, Kuo Li, Zhifan Wan, Dong Wang, Richard Wang, Yang Gao
papers.evidence: 面向机器人操作的指代表达理解与目标定位属于具身感知能力。
papers.tldr: 机器人操作中的语言目标定位需要适应同一对象的不同说法及附加上下文，但定位专家容易受指令变化影响，生成式视觉语言模型又可能漏找目标或无法拒绝不存在的目标。本文提出VLM引导的定位专家，将视觉语言模型的上下文表征与定位专家直接预测空间位置的能力结合，面向零个、一个或多个目标进行理解。该互补设计旨在提升机器人语言指令落地的完整性与稳健性。
papers.abstract_en: Generalised referring expression comprehension (GREC) aims to identify and localise the zero, one or multiple objects referred to by a language expression. In robotic manipulation, grounding also needs to remain accurate when requests for the same objects are paraphrased or embedded in additional context in robotics. However, grounding expert models are sensitive to instruction variation, while generative vision--language models (VLMs) struggle with complete target recovery and rejection of absent targets. These complementary limitations motivate combining the contextual representations of VLMs with the direct spatial prediction capabilities of grounding experts. We therefore introduce VLM-guided Grounding Expert (VGE), which combines a frozen VLM with a trainable grounding expert through layerwise joint attention and text-conditioned instance scoring. These interfaces leverage multimodal understanding of the VLM to guide object-query refinement and candidate selection while retaining direct bounding-box prediction. Across three datasets, VGE achieves the highest averaged F1 score among the evaluated methods on all five test splits, with differences of at most 1.2 percentage points across instruction conditions within each split. On the dataset with robotic scenes, VGE also achieves the highest F1 across instruction variants and no-target, single-target and multiple-target cases. VGE provides a $5.3$--$13.0\times$ inference speedup over the baseline with the same VLM base model. These results support combining VLM context with specialised spatial prediction to address both grounding challenges, with particularly strong performance in robotic scenes. Code will be released upon publication.

papers.title_en: Kolibri: Color Finds the Place, Refinement Sets the Pose for RGB-D Localization in Colored Point Clouds
papers.authors: Leonel Aguilar, Bartu Tuncay, Christoph Hoelscher
papers.evidence: 利用彩色点云和几何细化进行RGB-D相机位姿定位，契合几何视觉与机器人环境感知。
papers.tldr: 在未见过的扫描建筑中，RGB-D相机定位需要对齐帧数据与彩色点云，而传统配准计算成本较高。Kolibri将点云划分为局部单元，用小型图网络依据颜色、局部形状和邻接关系寻找地点，再交由几何细化确定姿态。在未见ScanNet房间上的定位精度与GeDi相当，每帧仅需82毫秒。该方法展示了学习式检索与几何优化结合的高效定位路径。
papers.abstract_en: An agent or robot in a scanned building must locate its camera in rooms that no model saw during training. Point cloud registration methods can align each RGB-D frame with the building's colored point cloud, accurately but at a high cost. We observe that geometric refinement brings nearby initial poses to the same final pose, so the learned component only needs to find the place. Kolibri does this with a graph network of 55,712 parameters that describes 10 cm cubes of points, called cells, by their color, local shape and neighbors. With the same refinement, it matches GeDi on 96 unseen ScanNet rooms (81.4% against 80.3% within 5 cm and 5°) and on a held-out test of 10 further rooms, in 82 ms per frame on an RTX 2080 Ti. The saved time allows for search without a room label. In one point cloud of 100 rooms, Kolibri loses 1.3 points against knowing the room, while retrieving the room first loses 56.0. In a hospital emergency department scene from a real scan, it localizes 86.5% of the frames rendered from the scan in 384 ms each, where GeDi needs 91 minutes per frame on cubes of the scan for a similar recall. The method needs colors that agree between the frame and the point cloud. On gray frames and across cameras with different color responses, point cloud registration methods keep the lead.

papers.title_en: Seeing 3D Occupancy Through Scene-Adaptive Projection
papers.authors: Yuan Wu, Zhiqiang Yan, Zhengxue Wang, Guangfa Wang, Jun Li, Jian Yang
papers.evidence: 通过深度引导投影改进多视图三维几何与语义占据预测。
papers.tldr: 多视图三维占据预测常将均匀分布的参考点投影到图像平面，因而会把采样浪费在空区域，难以充分利用有限预算。SAP提出场景自适应投影，以冻结深度模型预测的度量深度回投三维空间，并据此引导视图变换。该策略让采样更贴合非均匀场景几何，同时服务于体素级几何和语义推断。它为多视图三维场景理解提供了更有效的几何特征聚合方式。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-based 3D occupancy prediction infers voxel-wise geometry and semantics from multi-view images, where 2D-to-3D view transformation is a crucial step. Many existing methods adopt a backward-projection paradigm, projecting uniformly distributed 3D reference points onto image planes to aggregate multi-view features. However, their scene-agnostic sampling patterns overlook the non-uniform distribution of scene geometry, allocating many references to empty space and reducing sampling efficiency under a fixed sampling budget. To address this challenge, we propose SAP, a scene-adaptive projection framework that leverages depth-based geometric priors to guide view transformation. Specifically, we back-project metric depth maps predicted by a frozen depth model into 3D space to obtain geometric priors. To leverage these priors, we design a Scene-Adaptive Projection Encoder comprising two complementary components. First, Prior-Guided Reference Generation constructs a hybrid reference set for feature sampling, allocating references within prior-supported height regions and retaining full-range sampling where valid support is unavailable. Furthermore, to account for potential spatial misalignment caused by depth estimation errors, Radial-Structured Feature Aggregation explores multiple candidate locations through learned radial offsets to aggregate potentially displaced feature evidence. Extensive experiments on Occ3D demonstrate that SAP achieves state-of-the-art performance and consistently improves results across diverse occupancy frameworks.

papers.title_en: ViewAgent3D: A Training-Free Multi-View Pipeline for 3D Scene Understanding
papers.authors: Sarosij Bose, Arindam Dutta, Konstantinos Karydis, Amit K. Roy Chowdhury
papers.evidence: 通过由粗到细的多视图证据选择支持三维场景理解
papers.tldr: 许多三维场景问答方法依赖显式场景表示或专门训练的多模态模型，构建成本较高。ViewAgent3D改为从多视图图像中选择足以回答问题的证据，先将查询拆解为属性概念，再以由粗到细的流程筛选视角，并通过推理工具完成任务。该免训练方案支持多种三维场景理解查询，展示了利用视图选择提升场景分析效率的路径。
papers.abstract_en: 3D scene understanding tasks are often approached by building explicit 3D scene representations or by training specialized multi-modal models over point clouds, voxels, or scene graphs. We take a complementary view: for many queries, the main bottleneck is not the absence of a stronger 3D representation but the selection of a small subset of multi-view RGB views that actually makes the query answerable. We present a training-free, query-conditioned multi-view pipeline that performs diverse tasks using only 2D images and a set of tools used purely for inference. Our method first decomposes each query into a set of concepts that identify unique attributes that assist with reasoning. This drives a coarse-to-fine evidence selection process: a coarse retrieval selects and scores all views, a diversity-aware selector reduces redundancy, and a reranking stage helps shortlist views by target visibility or answerability. The resulting evidence is optionally grounded for queries that benefit from explicit localization, and a self-verification step helps refine the final response, especially for open-ended cases. Despite using no task-specific training and no explicit 3D representations at inference time, our approach provides approximately 10% gain on 3D VQA and 5% gain on dense captioning and Embodied QA while being applicable across different scenarios. We further propose a unique judge-based evaluation system, motivating a judge who takes into account many semantically correct or partially correct answers, thereby improving holistic scene understanding.

papers.title_en: Pixel2Perspective: A Benchmark for Multi-Modal and Multi-View Generalization in Vision-Language Models
papers.authors: Aditya Gandhamal, Aniruddh Sikdar, Arya Kishor, Suresh Sundaram
papers.evidence: 提出基准评估具身智能感知所需的开放词汇语义分割跨视角与跨环境泛化。
papers.tldr: 视觉语言模型和开放词汇语义分割可支持无人机及自动驾驶车辆识别未见物体，但真实户外环境中的天气变化、视角差异和域偏移仍带来挑战。Pixel2Perspective提出多模态、多视角泛化基准，重点考察文本驱动的像素级分割模型在复杂户外条件下的表现。该基准面向具身导航感知应用，有助于系统评估模型部署时的稳健性与不足。
papers.abstract_en: Embodied AI systems, such as drones and autonomous vehicles, improve navigation by enhancing perception in environments containing unseen objects. While Visual Language Models (VLMs) offer strong image understanding, their real-world application is underexplored. For effective deployment, open-vocabulary semantic segmentation (OVSS) models, leveraging models like CLIP to assign pixel-level labels from text, must be robust to outdoor conditions, adverse weather, and varying viewpoints. Despite their potential, these models encounter significant challenges in cross-domain generalization, hindering their practical use in embodied AI applications. In this work, we present Pixel2Perspective, a benchmark for multi-angle object localization and open-vocabulary segmentation across both aerial and ground perspectives. This benchmark supports thorough evaluation across different viewpoints and sensor modalities. We assess foundational models like CLIP and advanced OVSS models using a curated dataset that spans varied outdoor conditions, sim-to-real scenarios, and multiple sensors, including infrared, to support the development of robust and generalizable perception systems. We also present a novel framework, Multi-Source RGB-IR Uncertainty Quantification (MSRIQ), which jointly models aleatoric and epistemic uncertainties across RGB and infrared imagery. This approach supports robust evaluation of open-vocabulary segmentation models across diverse environmental conditions. Our work sets a robustness-driven benchmark, providing key insights and laying the foundation for future research in open-world embodied AI perception. The benchmark and project page are available at https://aniruddhsikdar1.github.io/publications/pixel2perspective/

papers.title_en: Mesh-Free Keypoint Learning for Category-Level 6D Object Pose Estimation
papers.authors: Junghoon Seo, Hakjin Lee, Jaehoon Sim
papers.evidence: 利用局部RGB-D几何估计类别级六自由度位姿，支持机器人感知操作对象
papers.tldr: 机器人面对类别中未见过的物体实例时，只能获得局部RGB-D观测，传统依赖注册实例表面的关键点支持构造也较为繁琐。MORSE-Pose提出无网格关键点学习方法，利用标准位姿与尺寸标注，将观测点映射到归一化物体坐标，并保留落在扩张容差包络内的点。该支持区域跨相机坐标和度量尺度保持一致，为类别级六自由度位姿估计提供更直接的几何监督，有助于机器人识别和操作新实例。
papers.abstract_en: Category-level 6D pose estimation relates partial RGB-D observations of unseen instances to a canonical frame shared across a category. Object-aware reconstruction helps adaptive keypoints retain the geometry of the visible surface. Common reconstruction targets select observed points by their distance to a registered instance surface. We present MORSE-Pose, which derives this support directly from standard pose and metric-size annotations. We map observed 3D points to normalized object coordinates and retain those inside a tolerance-dilated pose-and-size envelope. This construction is consistent across camera frames and metric scales. When the annotated extent bounds the object surface, the envelope conservatively contains the support of a conventional surface-distance selector. We integrate this target with multi-level RGB-D features, adaptive keypoints, and learnable category context. Experiments on REAL275 and HouseCat6D show that the envelope closely matches surface-based supervision at both point and task levels, remains stable under boundary perturbations and viewpoint changes, and supports competitive category-level pose accuracy across benchmarks.

papers.title_en: AdaPixFlow: Learning Continuous-Time 3D Dynamics Across Scenes from Sparse Multi-view Observations
papers.authors: Hrishikesh Viswanath, Aniket Bera
papers.evidence: 从多视角观测学习连续时间三维动态并预测未观测时刻运动
papers.tldr: 动态场景中的物体运动建模常依赖针对单个场景优化，或预设物理与运动学假设，限制了跨场景应用。AdaPixFlow从多视角RGB-D观测学习连续时间动力学算子，将不同相机的信息融合到世界坐标系的共享体素网格，再预测物体的三维运动状态。该方法无需逐场景优化或预先指定运动模型，面向未观测时刻的运动预测，为环境动态建模提供可迁移方案。
papers.abstract_en: Understanding how objects move in dynamic scenes requires recovering their 3D motion from visual observations and predicting their positions at unobserved times. Existing methods either optimize scene-specific velocity fields or impose predefined physical and kinematic assumptions. We instead study learning a continuous-time dynamics operator across scenes, mapping multi-view visual observations to 3D object kinematics. We introduce Adaptive Pixel Flows (\ours{}), which learns this operator from multi-view RGB-D observations without per-scene optimization or predefined motion models. The method fuses observations from all cameras into a shared voxel grid in world coordinates, from which the network predicts a continuous-time velocity field. Because the operator is trained across scenes, it learns motion priors that carry over to unseen scenes. The field can then be integrated from observed states to predict object positions between observations and beyond the observed sequence. On held-out PhysInOne scenes, \ours{} improves F1 over the strongest competing method by 2.5\% for in-between prediction and 15\% for future prediction. Compared with per-scene velocity-field methods, the improvements are 30\% and 85\%, respectively. Applied zero-shot to Spring-Gaus, it improves future-prediction F1 by 12\%.

papers.title_en: Decompose, Verify, Evolve: Physically Grounded Shape Decomposition
papers.authors: Wenchao Ma, Rui Yu, Fan Zhu, Jiachen Liu, Sharon X. Huang
papers.evidence: 借助点云反馈和物理验证，将形状分解为语义及材质感知的几何部件。
papers.tldr: 现有形状分解方法通常着重几何拟合，可能产生部件断开或物理上不稳定的重建结果。本文提出PhysDec，利用视觉语言模型的语义理解与常识推理，从少量图像预测具有材质信息的几何基元分解；其循环流程再通过参考点云反馈和物理验证器迭代修正部件结构。该研究面向物体而非完整场景，但其语义部件分解与物理约束思路可为层级三维结构建模提供方法借鉴。
papers.abstract_en: Shape decomposition represents 3D objects as a compact set of geometric primitives for interpretable modeling and simulation. However, existing decomposition methods are trained primarily for geometric fidelity, without explicit constraints on physical plausibility, and can therefore produce disconnected parts or physically unstable reconstructions. We present PhysDec, an agentic framework that draws on a pretrained vision-language model's semantic understanding and commonsense reasoning to predict material-aware primitive decompositions from a few images. Within this framework, PhysDec-Loop is an agentic pipeline that reasons about part structure and materials, using a reference 3D point cloud for geometric feedback and physical verifiers to guide iterative refinement. Through self-evolution, we further develop another agentic pipeline, PhysDec-Evolved, which learns from prior corrections to predict primitive decompositions from images without point-cloud feedback or a correction loop at inference. Experiments show that PhysDec-Loop improves geometric fidelity, physical plausibility and visual quality over geometry-focused baselines, while PhysDec-Evolved approaches its performance at substantially lower inference cost.

papers.title_en: Multi-View Transformer with Geometry-Guided Multi-Modal ControlNet for 3D Virtual Try-On
papers.authors: Sarthak Batra, Armin Mustafa, Adrian Hilton
papers.evidence: 多视角Transformer联合编辑三维高斯泼溅视图，提升跨视角外观与几何一致性
papers.tldr: 三维虚拟试穿若逐张独立编辑训练视图，融合后容易出现纹理漂移、印花模糊以及新视角下不合理的几何形状。GS-VTON-MVT提出结合隐式与显式三维推理的多阶段框架，使用多视角Transformer联合编辑训练视图，并以几何引导的多模态控制促进视图间协调。该方法面向三维高斯泼溅表示中的跨视角一致性问题，为多视图Transformer处理三维场景编辑提供了可借鉴方案。
papers.abstract_en: Editing a 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) capture of a person so that they wear a new garment requires every rendered view to agree on the same garment details. Existing 3D virtual try-on (VTON) pipelines, however, edit training views largely independently and fuse them with hand-designed heuristics such as manually chosen reference views and fixed attention-blending weights. The resulting inconsistencies are baked into the 3D representation and surface as texture drift, blurred prints, and implausible geometry in novel views. We present GS-VTON-MVT, a three-stage framework that combines implicit and explicit 3D reasoning for consistent 3DGS try-on. (i) A multi-view inpainting transformer jointly edits a set of training views with full cross-view self-attention, so that cross-view correspondence is learned rather than imposed. (ii) A geometry-guided multi-modal ControlNet conditions the diffusion editor on the garment image together with depth and surface normals rendered from the current 3DGS state, supplying explicit structure where visual evidence is weakest. (iii) A pose-adaptive persona-aware attention replaces the fixed blending weight between current-view and reference-view features with weights derived from camera-pose proximity. On the 3D-VTONBench benchmark, GS-VTON-MVT improves FID, KID, LPIPS-based cross-view consistency, and user preference over general-purpose 3D editors and prior 3D try-on methods.

papers.title_en: ReMiC: Representation-Driven Token Pruning for 3D VLMs via Minimax Hierarchical Clustering
papers.authors: Bangfeng Yan, Chaoning Zhang, Yuanhao Liu, Pengcheng Zheng, Mengyuan Li, Wei Dong, Sheng Zheng, Yang Yang
papers.evidence: 以极小极大层次聚类压缩三维场景理解中的多视角表征。
papers.tldr: 三维视觉语言模型依赖多视角输入，产生的长视觉词元序列带来较高推理开销，而仅按显著性或特征多样性筛选容易遗漏原场景表征。本文提出无需训练的代表性驱动剪枝方法，通过极小极大层次聚类选择词元，并将保留词元视为原集合的原型。该设计针对压缩后的表征缺口进行建模，旨在以更紧凑的输入支持三维场景理解与空间推理。
papers.abstract_en: 3D vision-language models (3D VLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in 3D scene understanding and spatial reasoning. However, their reliance on multi-view inputs produces long visual token sequences, imposing substantial computational overhead during inference. Existing pruning methods often rely on token salience or feature diversity as proxies for representativeness, without explicitly modeling the representation gap between the original token set and the retained subset, thereby leading to suboptimal representation of the original scene. In this paper, we propose ReMiC, a training-free, representation-driven token pruning framework based on minimax hierarchical clustering. ReMiC treats retained tokens as prototypes for the original observations, formulating pruning as minimizing the maximum representation error under a fixed token budget. Local prototype initialization allocates tokens according to regional representation needs, while global prototype refinement updates the selected prototypes using cross-region information to further reduce the maximum representation error. Extensive experiments conducted on three representative 3D VLMs across five 3D scene understanding benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness and generalization of our method. Notably, by retaining only 10% of visual tokens, ReMiC preserves 93.2% of the performance of Video-3D LLM and achieves a $2.04\times$ faster inference speed.

papers.title_en: ENGRAM: Reliability-Weighted Latent Fusion and Occlusion-Aware Layered Readout for Video World Models
papers.authors: Chenhao Wu, Zhaolong Su, Yang Liu, Tianrui Su, Yingguang Yang, Shang Luo, Yancheng Chen, Chongyang Zhang, Hao Zheng, Kefu Xu, Congjing Ran, Bin Chong
papers.evidence: 融合多次观测并读取不同深度层的证据，形成共享空间表示，与三维场景建模相关。
papers.tldr: 以相机轨迹为条件生成视频的世界模型需要维持三维一致性，但简单合并记忆会重复保留观测，而只读取最前层又会忽略遮挡后证据。ENGRAM通过可靠性加权融合几何与视觉兼容的潜在观测，并以遮挡感知的分层读取访问不同深度信息。该机制整合重复证据并构建共享空间记忆，为相机控制视频生成提供更完整的场景表示。
papers.abstract_en: Camera-conditioned video world models aim to generate 3D-consistent videos from a single image along specified camera trajectories. However, set-union updates in latent spatial memory leave repeated observations unconsolidated, while frontmost-only readout limits simultaneous access to stored evidence at different depths. To address these limitations, we present ENGRAM, a latent spatial memory framework combining reliability-weighted latent fusion and occlusion-aware layered readout. Specifically, recursive fusion integrates geometrically and visually compatible observations in a channel-normalized latent space, consolidating repeated evidence into a shared scene representation. Layered readout exposes multiple depth-ordered latent candidates with their reliability and availability at each target cell. This gives the generator access to information from multiple surfaces as visibility changes. Explicit camera rays provide viewpoint information independently of memory coverage, while geometric consistency constraints guide memory updates. Memory retrieval uses a single projection at latent resolution, avoiding intermediate RGB rendering and VAE re-encoding. We adapt a pretrained video generator using only 256 training scenes. On 100 RealEstate10K test scenes, ENGRAM improves novel-view-synthesis and closed-loop PSNRs over Spatia by 0.82 and 4.48 dB, respectively. On a 200-case WorldScore evaluation subset, it achieves an average score of 67.78, exceeding Spatia by 3.31 points. Project page: https://wchkoutian.github.io/engram-website/.

papers.title_en: Learning Continuous Scene Depth Representations via Cross-Modal Gaussian Rendering
papers.authors: Zhiwei Zhong, Lingyu Zhu, Baoliang Chen, Peilin Chen, Shiqi Wang
papers.evidence: 学习连续场景深度表示，以支持任意尺度的彩色引导深度超分辨率
papers.tldr: 深度超分辨率需要利用彩色图像结构恢复高分辨率几何，但不少方法只支持预设整数放大倍数；隐式方法虽能适配任意尺度，却可能计算昂贵并遗漏清晰边界与细节。本文提出跨模态高斯渲染框架，学习连续场景深度表示，以彩色信息辅助灵活尺度的深度重建。该思路针对不同分辨率差异下的深度恢复需求，旨在兼顾任意尺度适配与结构细节表达，为几何场景理解提供深度超分辨率方案。
papers.abstract_en: Depth super-resolution with color guidance is a fundamental problem in geometric scene understanding that aims to reconstruct high-resolution depth using structural cues from color images. In practical RGB-D systems, the resolution gap between depth and color images often varies, requiring flexible upsampling factors. However, many existing methods are designed for predefined integer scales. Although implicit methods support arbitrary-scale reconstruction, they typically rely on computationally demanding per-pixel neural decoding and may struggle to recover sharp depth boundaries and fine structures. To this end, we propose a cross-modal Gaussian rendering framework that learns continuous depth representations for arbitrary-scale depth super-resolution. Specifically, we first construct hierarchical Gaussian representations for progressive depth reconstruction, with explicit spatial support defined by learnable Gaussian primitives. Building on this representation, we design a Structure-Aware Gaussian Aggregation module that combines spatial weights with cross-modal feature affinities to reduce aggregation across depth discontinuities. We then develop a Scale-Adaptive Gaussian Rendering module that adapts Gaussian spatial kernels to the target pixel footprint. To further facilitate cross-modal learning, we propose a training strategy that gradually introduces higher-frequency guidance information during training. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method at both in-distribution and out-of-distribution upsampling scales.
